layerContract.base: base.png — V4 portrait/head/background silhouette with no eyes, eyebrows or mouth baked into the face area; NEVER use old PixelGlitch V2 art
layerContract.expressions: expressions/{expression}.png — aligned transparent full-canvas EYES/EYEBROWS layer; no mouth baked in
layerContract.mouth: mouth/{shape}.png — aligned transparent full-canvas independent MOUTH layer, no jaw/eyes or whole-face replacement
layerContract.approval: Every PNG individually redrawn to match the new approved V4 design, aligned on same 512x512 native canvas and owner-reviewed before assetsReady=true.
layerContract.body: Independent body motion requires separate true V4 body rig/animations. Facial layers are a headshot system, NOT walking or arm movements.

voicePolicy.noAudioOrNoWaveform: rest mouth; never claim lip sync
voicePolicy.audioRms: only small/medium/wide/round generic mouth-open intensity proxies (not phonemes)
